raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

On Hopper/Blackwell with `tensor_parallel_size > 1` and flashinfer installed, building the engine config initializes CUDA in the calling process. vLLM then sees "CUDA is initialized" and overrides `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD` from `fork` to `spawn`, which logs a warning on every `LLM()` call and breaks tests that rely on monkeypatching (`tests/v1/shutdown/`).

Addresses item 1 under "Side effects at import time" in #59433.

## Root cause

`PassConfig.default_fi_allreduce_fusion_max_size_mb()` imported the whole `allreduce_rms_fusion` pass module just to read the `FI_ALLREDUCE_FUSION_MAX_SIZE_MB` table. That module imports `flashinfer.comm` at module level, and importing it initializes CUDA. The import direction was backwards: config resolution should not depend on a pass module.

```
create_engine_config() → PassConfig.flashinfer_max_size()
  → default_fi_allreduce_fusion_max_size_mb()
  → import allreduce_rms_fusion → import flashinfer.comm → CUDA initialized
```

## Fix

Move `FI_ALLREDUCE_FUSION_MAX_SIZE_MB` into `vllm/config/compilation.py` and drop the cross-module import. `allreduce_rms_fusion.py` never read the table, and its own flashinfer import is unchanged. Also replace the stale copy of the table in the `PassConfig` docstring with a pointer to the single definition. No runtime logic change.

`tests/standalone_tests/lazy_imports.py` now also asserts that `PassConfig().flashinfer_max_size(2)` does not import the fusion pass module.

## Test Plan

```bash
python3 tests/standalone_tests/lazy_imports.py
cd tests && python3 -m pytest -v --import-mode=append \
    'v1/shutdown/test_forward_error.py::test_async_llm_model_error' \
    'v1/shutdown/test_forward_error.py::test_llm_model_error'
```

## Test Result

GB300 (cc 10.3), upstream nightly image `nightly-40941f2c4` (main), 5 fresh-process runs each:

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `torch.cuda.is_initialized()` after `PassConfig().flashinfer_max_size(2)` | True | False |
| `flashinfer` in `sys.modules` | True | False |
| `PassConfig().flashinfer_max_size(2)` time | 3.3–4.6 s (median ≈3.4 s) | 0.1 ms |
| Modules imported by that call | 2138 | 0 |
| Returned value | 67108864 | 67108864 |
| `create_engine_config()`, TP=2, tiny model, `enforce_eager`, warm cache (median) | 4.3 s | 2.7 s |
| `torch.cuda.is_initialized()` after `create_engine_config()` | True | False |

The new `lazy_imports.py` check fails on main and passes with this change.

On the original branch (before the rebase), the three `tests/v1/shutdown/test_forward_error.py` cases that failed under the forced `spawn` pass, and the spawn warning is gone.

This takes flashinfer off the API server's path only; workers still import it where they need it.

AI assistance: prepared with Claude Code; I reviewed every changed line and ran the measurements above myself.

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `torch.cuda.is_initialized()` after `PassConfig().flashinfer_max_size(2)` | True | False |
| `flashinfer` in `sys.modules` | True | False |
| fusion pass module in `sys.modules` | True | False |
| `PassConfig().flashinfer_max_size(2)` | ~3.45 s | 0.1 ms |

`flashinfer_max_size(ws)` returns the same values on both for ws = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 (`None`, 64 MiB, 64 MiB, 4 MiB, 64 MiB), the fusion pass module still imports, and `tests/standalone_tests/lazy_imports.py` from this branch passes. I couldn't check `create_engine_config()` with TP=2 on a single GPU.

LGTM. One optional nit: the `fi_allreduce_fusion_max_size_mb` docstring now uses the Sphinx role `:data:`; plain backticks may read better since vLLM uses Google-style docstrings (AGENTS.md).

FYI #65589 and #65590 (also from #59433) append to the end of `lazy_imports.py` too, so whichever of these lands later needs a trivial rebase. I'll handle mine.

@@ -23,3 +23,15 @@
 
 import vllm  # noqa
 import vllm.config  # noqa
+
+# Resolving config defaults must not import the allreduce fusion pass module:
+# it eagerly imports `flashinfer.comm`, whose import initializes CUDA in the
+# API server process and makes vLLM force the `spawn` multiprocessing method.
+from vllm.config.compilation import PassConfig  # noqa
+
+PassConfig().flashinfer_max_size(2)
+_FUSION_PASS = "vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.allreduce_rms_fusion"
+assert _FUSION_PASS not in sys.modules, (
+    "PassConfig.flashinfer_max_size() imported the allreduce fusion pass "
+    "module, which initializes CUDA as an import side effect"
+)
